role: boss tell: Redline Counter guard stance (do not strike into it from the front)
style: stylized anime combat, dark storm stage, one red element
dominant_shape: a crackling red crescent barrier standing in front of the caster, over a red ring on the floor

beats.name: open
beats.expect: A long thin red line cut across his chest, the floor ring snapping open, a red bloom

beats.name: barrier lit
beats.expect: The crescent in front of him lit along its whole length, arcs jumping between its points

beats.name: hold
beats.expect: The barrier still crackles with different arcs; the ring flows round; nothing white-hot

beats.name: break
beats.expect: The crescent breaks from the top down; sparks kick out from its points

beats.name: landed
beats.expect: Sparks have fallen and bounced on the floor in front of him; ring faded

acceptance: The barrier is in front of him (his facing side) and reads as a wall, not a halo
The hold keeps changing (re-struck arcs, flowing ring) without a white flash
The break is visible as falling sparks, not a switch-off
avoid: A full closed circle around him
